udibr_fisheye_0S9A9186_head.bin holds the first 4037 bytes (the ftyp and meta boxes, no image data) of
examples/0S9A9186.heic of https://github.com/udibr/fisheye at commit 05daec9c8a943254b564582b32ed25525b0558d4
(an Apple spatial photo written by Apple ImageIO, 2 177 411 bytes in full). The tests of the HEIC stereo pair probe
read it. That project is published under the MIT licence:
